assessments.reasoning: tag_document is the official spdx/license-list-data Git tag API object. Its tag, message, object.type and object.sha bind v3.29.0 to the data commit. The 700-byte response has SHA-256 9695bf0c0fae8f1db7f1bee44d2176c06a045a3fb62f1ab9aa4b4cef283ebd13.
osi_document supplies OSI’s own title, page link and displayed SPDX identifier in the exact November 24 CMS revision.
detail_document supplies SPDX’s name, licenseId, crossRef and seeAlso fields at the target commit. The connector provides individual byte ranges and digests for those four fields.

limitations: The tag API reports verification.verified false and verification.reason “unsigned”. Its repository origin and target were inspected through the official API.

The correspondence establishes publisher labels and a documentary reference. Historical priority, approval history, project adoption, and exact equivalence across OSI and SPDX representations remain unresolved.
reasoning: At commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, SPDX json/details/MIT.json gives name “MIT License” and licenseId “MIT”. The SPDX repository’s annotated tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b names v3.29.0 and identifies that exact data commit as its target.
